full_judgment: 12. On the other hand Mr Hefzul Bari with Mrs. Khalifa Shamsun Nahar the Learned advocates appearing for the respondents bank opposing the Rule submit that the petitioner having failed to make repayment of loan to the bank, inspite of repeated demands, the respondents bank published auction notice in the daily Ghaaghat and Amar Desh for sale of the mortgaged property as per section 12 of the Ain. In response to the auction notices 3 bidders participated in the auction held on 26-11-2008 and among the 3 bidders quotation of one Rosna Khatun was accepted as the highest at Taka 4, l 2,000. After acceptance of the quotation of Rosna Khatun she paid the bid money and thereafter sale deed was executed on 15-12-2008 and subsequently possession of the land was also delivered to her on 4-5-2009 through Executive Magistrate with the knowledge of the petitioner. It is also argued that the petitioner to create obstruction in delivering possession to the auction purchaser has filed a case under section 144 of the Code Of Criminal Procedure which was rejected. He further submits that the petitioner knowing fully well about auction sale and having failed in his attempt to obstruct the delivery of possession after 2 years of auction sale filed this petition only to harass the respondent bank. It is asserted that there was no irregularity or illegality in the process of holding auction and, as such, the present Rule is liable to be discharged.
